input.quote: 2.1 Customer commits to purchase at least USD 2,000,000 of Services in each of the next three years on a take-or-pay basis, without reduction or termination rights.
input.rationale: Section 9 grants only for-cause, insolvency and Vendor-fault termination rights (9.1-9.3, 9.5), and Sections 8.2 (non-renewal) and 27.3 (force majeure exit) are conditional substitutes only. There is no Customer right to terminate for convenience anywhere, and Section 2.1 affirmatively bars termination rights across a three-year take-or-pay commitment - walk-away territory under T4C. Vendor likewise has no convenience right, so we added the missing Customer right at the preferred level (30 days' notice, pro-rata refund of prepaid Fees) as new Section 9.4, expressly confirmed Vendor has no convenience exit during a committed term, and conformed Section 2.1 so the take-or-pay bar no longer contradicts it while preserving the no-reduction restriction.

mappings.element: Customer may terminate the Agreement or an Order Form for convenience.
Customer's convenience termination requires no more than 30 days' written notice.
Vendor refunds prepaid fees pro rata after Customer's convenience termination.
Vendor has no right to terminate for convenience during a committed term.

proposal.summary: Add Customer termination for convenience on 30 days' notice with pro-rata refund; confirm no Vendor convenience right; conform take-or-pay bar in 2.1
proposal.comment: [Playbook] We added a Customer right to terminate for convenience on thirty days' notice with a pro-rata refund of prepaid Fees, and confirmed Vendor has no convenience exit during a committed term; we also conformed the take-or-pay language in Section 2.1 so it no longer bars that right while keeping the no-reduction commitment intact. If helpful, we can move to 60-90 days' notice with an early-termination fee capped at three months' Fees.

ops.text: Customer may terminate this Agreement or any Order Form for convenience, in whole or in part, on thirty days' prior written notice to Vendor, and Vendor shall refund prepaid Fees pro rata for the period after the effective date of termination. Vendor may not terminate this Agreement or an Order Form for convenience during a committed term.

ops.oldText: on a take-or-pay basis, without reduction or termination rights.
ops.newText: on a take-or-pay basis, without reduction rights but subject to Section 9.4.
